# Geunhyeong Lee

> Scientist at the Facility for Rare Isotope Beams (FRIB), Michigan State University. Research connects AI-driven thermal-fluid design, multiphysics modeling, 3D printing, and experimental validation for nuclear systems.

This optional discovery index links to the site's public research records. Article pages include author-written abstracts from the linked PDFs, publication metadata, and citation downloads. DOI links identify the published versions.
